Definition: Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple
BiblicalUsage: Boaz = "fleetness"; 1) ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi; 2) name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
